desc:
WHIPPED FROSTING: A delicious artificially flavored chocolate frosting with a light, airy texture; Goes great with baked goods such as cakes, cupcakes, and cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just pop open the can, spread the frosting, and enjoy

A TRUSTED FAVORITE: Makes a perfect base for sprinkles and other fun decorations; Try our frosting with other trusted favorites such as Betty Crocker Cake Mix or Brownie Mix

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free frosting is an ideal pantry staple; Keep this Betty Crocker frosting on hand with baking supplies for your impromptu baking needs

CONTAINS: Eight 12 oz tubs of Betty Crocker Whipped Artificially Flavored Chocolate Frosting
features:
Key Features:

Smooth, creamy texture that’s easy to spread.

Classic milk chocolate flavor that appeals to all ages.

Ready to use—no mixing, whipping, or additional ingredients needed.

Gluten-free and suitable for a wide range of dietary needs.

Perfect for frosting cakes, cupcakes, cookies, and more.

Benefits:

Saves time during baking and decorating—just open and spread.

Consistent quality and flavor every time you use it.

Kid-friendly and party-ready, making it ideal for birthdays, holidays, and events.

Can be used straight from the tub or as a base for your own custom flavors and colors.
ingredients: Sugar, Palm Oil, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Water, Cocoa Processed with Alkali. Contains 2% or less of: Corn Starch, Monoglycerides, Cellulose Gel, Salt, Citric Acid, Polysorbate 80, Sodium Acid Pyrophosphate, Cellulose Gum, Carrageenan, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Freshness Preserved by Potassium Sorbate.
